blocks.en: Deep learning shows promise for breast cancer diagnosis, but limited interpretability hinders clinical adoption. We benchmark ten ImageNet-pretrained models (ResNet50, VGG19, InceptionV3, DenseNet121, Xception, MobileNetV2, EfficientNet, ConvNeXt, ViT, and Swin Transformer) for benign-versus-malignant classification on the BreakHis histopathology dataset using a patient-level split, and explain their predictions with Grad-CAM, LIME, Integrated Gradients, and LRP. DenseNet121 performed best, with 99.4% test accuracy and an AUC-ROC of 0.999, and significantly outperformed all other models (p < 0.001). Transformer-based models trailed the CNNs. The explanations consistently highlighted nuclei-rich and glandular regions of diagnostic relevance. Combining transfer learning with explainable AI can thus yield accurate, interpretable tools for breast cancer diagnosis.
blocks.zh: 深入的学习显示了乳腺癌诊断的希望,但有限的可解释性阻碍了临床的采纳. 我们以10个图像网预限模型(ResNet50、VGG19、InceptionV3、DenseNet121、Xception、MobileNetV2、OxilNet、ConvNeXt、VIT和Swin Transformer)为基准,利用患者的分级方法,对断裂式组织病理数据集进行良性与恶性分类,并用Grad-CAM、LIME、综合梯度和LRP来解释其预测。 DenseNet121的性能最好,测试精度为99.4%,AUC-ROC为0.999,并显著地超过了所有其他型号(p < 0.001)。 基于变形器的模型跟随有线电视新闻网. 这些解释始终强调具有诊断相关性的多核体和腺体区域。 因此,将转移学习与可解释的人工智能结合起来,可以产生准确、可解释的乳腺癌诊断工具。

blocks.en: Breast cancer is among the most common and lethal malignancies impacting women globally. The World Health Organization reports over 2.3 million new cases and over 680,000 deaths per year, establishing it as a primary cause of cancer-related mortality in women [ 1 ] . Timely and precise identification of breast cancer is crucial for enhancing treatment efficacy, survival probabilities, and the overall quality of life for patients [ 2 ] . Traditional diagnostic methods, including mammography, histological examination, and ultrasound imaging, while useful, are prone to inter-observer variability, necessitate professional interpretation, and may overlook small abnormalities in the early stages [ 3 ] . These constraints have catalyzed the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) and deep learning (DL) methodologies in medical imaging to aid radiologists in achieving precise and prompt diagnosis [ 4 ] , [ 5 ] .
blocks.zh: 乳腺癌是影响全球妇女的最常见和致命的恶性肿瘤之一。 世界卫生组织每年报告230多万例新病例,超过680 000人死亡,确定这是妇女癌症相关死亡率的主要原因[1]。 及时、准确地识别乳腺癌对于提高治疗效力、存活概率和患者总体生活质量至关重要。 传统的诊断方法,包括乳房X线照相、组织学检查和超声波成像,虽然有用,但容易出现观测器之间的变异,需要专业解释,可能忽略早期的小异常[3]. 这些制约因素推动了人工智能(AI)和深层学习(DL)方法在医学成像中的结合,以帮助放射学家实现准确而迅速的诊断[4],[5].

blocks.en: Deep learning, especially convolutional neural networks (CNNs), has demonstrated exceptional efficacy in visual recognition tasks, encompassing medical image classification, segmentation, and detection [ 6 ] . Numerous research have utilized CNN architectures, including VGG, ResNet, Inception, and DenseNet, for breast cancer classification, with remarkable accuracy [ 1 ] . Nonetheless, these models frequently necessitate substantial quantities of annotated training data and considerable computational resources, posing challenges in the medical field where labeled data is limited and costly to obtain [ 7 ] . Furthermore, deep learning models are often criticized for their opacity and lack of interpretability, presenting a substantial obstacle to clinical implementation [ 8 ] . Comprehending the rationale behind a model’s decision-making process is essential in healthcare applications, as erroneous predictions can lead to severe repercussions [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 深度学习,特别是进化神经网络(CNNs),在视觉识别任务中表现出了超乎寻常的效果,包括医学影像分类,分化,检测[6]. 许多研究利用CNN架构,包括VGG、ResNet、Inception和DenseNet,对乳腺癌进行分类,其精确度显著[1]。 然而,这些模式往往需要大量附加说明的培训数据和大量计算资源,在医疗领域构成挑战,因为贴有标签的数据有限,获取[7]费用高昂。 此外,深层学习模式往往因其不透明和缺乏可解释性而受到批评,对临床实施构成重大障碍[8]. 完善模型决策程序的基本原理对于医疗应用至关重要,因为错误的预测可能导致严重影响[9]。

blocks.en: To mitigate data scarcity and enhance model generalisability, transfer learning has emerged as an effective technique that facilitates the utilization of pretrained models on extensive datasets (e.g., ImageNet) for domain-specific applications such as breast cancer classification [ 10 ] , [ 11 ] . Transfer learning decreases computational demands and training duration while improving performance on limited, specialized medical datasets. The use of Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) techniques, including Grad-CAM, LIME, SHAP, and XRAI, has created new opportunities for visualizing model behavior, enhancing clinician trust, and streamlining regulatory approval [ 7 ] , [ 12 ] .
blocks.zh: 为了缓解数据稀缺,增强模型的通用性,转移学习已经成为一种有效的技术,它有助于在广泛的数据集(如ImageNet)上使用经过预先培训的模型,用于乳腺癌分类等特定领域应用[10],[11]. 转移学习减少了计算需求和培训期限,同时改善了有限的专门医疗数据集的绩效。 使用解释性人工智能技术,包括Grad-CAM、LIME、SHAP和XRAI,为可视化模型行为、增强临床医生信任和简化监管审批创造了新的机会。

blocks.en: This paper presents a comprehensive and interpretable deep learning framework that integrates various transfer learning models with explainable artificial intelligence methodologies for robust breast cancer classification [ 8 ] . We assess ten cutting-edge models, ResNet50, VGG19, InceptionV3, DenseNet121, Xception, MobileNetV2, EfficientNetV2S, EfficientNet-B7, Vision Transformer (ViT), and Swin Transformer, across four prevalent breast cancer datasets [ 13 ] . To improve model performance and generalisation, we employ customised data augmentation methods, normalisation, and patch-based image preprocessing [ 4 ] . Additionally, we incorporate various XAI techniques to deliver both local and global interpretability, assisting physicians in comprehending the reasoning behind the model’s predictions [ 3 ] .
blocks.zh: 本文提出一个全面且可解释的深度学习框架,将各种转移学习模式与可解释的人工智能方法相结合,用于强力乳腺癌分类[8]. 我们评估了十个前沿模型,即ResNet50、VGG19、InceptionV3、DenseNet121、Xception、MobileNetV2、InceptNetV2S、Incept-B7、ViT和Swin Transformer,这些模型跨越四个流行的乳腺癌数据集[13]。 为了改进模型性能和概括性,我们采用了自定义的数据增强方法、正常化和基于补丁的图像预处理[4]。 此外,我们采用了各种XAI技术,以提供当地和全球的可解释性,协助医生理解模型预测背后的理由[3]。

blocks.en: The subsequent sections of this work are structured as follows: Section 1 delineates the pertinent literature and recent progress in deep learning for breast cancer diagnosis. Section 2 delineates the datasets employed, encompassing their structure, clinical context, and preparation procedures. Section 3 delineates the methodology, encompassing model architectures, transfer learning procedures, data augmentation techniques, and explainability methods. Section 4 delineates the experimental configuration and assessment criteria. Section 5 examines the outcomes derived from various models and datasets. Section 6 ultimately summarises the paper by presenting insights, limitations, and prospective future directions.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的以下各节的结构如下: 第1节描述了有关文献以及乳腺癌诊断深入学习的最新进展。 第2节描述了所使用的数据集,包括其结构、临床背景和准备程序。 第3节描述了方法,包括模型结构、转移学习程序、数据增强技术和解释性方法。 第4节规定了试验配置和评估标准。 第5节审查了各种模型和数据集产生的结果。 第6节最后总结了文件,提出了见解、局限性和未来的方向。

blocks.en: Breast cancer remains a major global health issue and one of the leading causes of cancer-related deaths among women. Early and precise detection is still crucial for improving prognosis, providing timely treatment, and enhancing survival rates [ 6 ] . In recent years, deep learning (DL) algorithms have demonstrated exceptional potential for automating breast cancer diagnosis by understanding complicated patterns from medical pictures. However, a number of difficulties remain that prevent widespread clinical implementation [ 13 ] . Key drawbacks include a lack of model generalisability across varied patient groups, biases caused by uneven or insufficient datasets, and a lack of transparency in decision-making. Many contemporary DL models behave like "black boxes," making it difficult for clinicians to trust and interpret their predictions [ 6 ] . To fill these gaps, we present a complete system that combines a variety of pre-trained transfer learning modelsj, including EfficientNetV2S, InceptionResNetV2, and XceptionNet, among others, with explainable AI (XAI) techniques such as LIME and Faster Score-CAM [ 5 ] . This integration intends to improve classification performance while also providing interpretable insights into the model’s predictions, allowing for better informed and reliable clinical decision-making.
blocks.zh: 乳腺癌仍然是全球主要健康问题,也是妇女死于癌症的主要原因之一。 早期和精确的检测对于改进预测、及时治疗和提高存活率仍然至关重要。 近年来,深层学习(DL)算法通过从医学图片中了解复杂的规律,证明了将乳腺癌诊断自动化的特殊潜力. 然而,仍然存在一些阻碍广泛临床实施的困难[13]. 主要缺点包括不同患者群体缺乏模式通用性,数据集不均衡或不足造成偏见,以及决策缺乏透明度。 许多当代的DL模型行为类似"黑盒",使得临床医生难以信任和解释他们的预测[6]. 为了填补这些空白,我们提出了一个完整的系统,将各种经过预先培训的转移学习模式j ,包括 " 高效的NetV2S " 、 " IncepionResNetV2 " 和 " XceptionNet " 等,结合了LIME和 " 更快的分数-CAM " 等解释性AI(XAI)技术。 这种整合旨在改进分类性能,同时对模型的预测提供可解释的深刻见解,以便进行更知情和可靠的临床决策。

blocks.en: Silva-Aravena et al. [2023] [ 14 ] introduced a hybrid machine learning and explainable artificial intelligence system for the early prevention of breast cancer, utilizing risk factor analysis on an Indonesian dataset of 400 persons (200 cases and 200 controls). The system utilized an XGBoost ensemble, compared with logistic regression, SVMs, and random forests, following the CRISP-ML(Q) framework to guarantee transparency and quality [ 7 ] . Preprocessing encompassed feature encoding and stratified division of lifestyle and reproductive variables, resulting in 85% accuracy. SHAP explanations identified high-fat diet, absence of breastfeeding, and familial predisposition as significant risk factors; but, the study’s limited, self-reported dataset constrains generalisability.
blocks.zh: Silva-Aravena等人 [2023] [14] 采用了混合机器学习和可解释的人工智能系统,用于早期预防乳腺癌,利用印度尼西亚400人数据集的风险因素分析(200个病例和200个控制器). 该系统采用XGBoost组合,与后勤回归、SVMs和随机森林相比较,遵循CRISP-ML(Q)框架,以确保透明度和质量[7]。 预处理包括特征编码和分层划分生活方式和生殖变量,结果准确度达到85%。 SHAP的解释认为高脂肪饮食、没有母乳喂养和家庭倾向是重大风险因素;但是,该研究的有限、自我报告的数据集限制了普遍性。

blocks.en: Nasir et al. [2025] [ 15 ] performed a comparative deep learning analysis on the Breast Cancer Wisconsin Diagnostic Dataset (569 cases, 33 tumor characteristics), assessing CNNs, RNNs, MLPs, and hybrid models (CNN+LSTM, CNN+MLP), in addition to pretrained VGG16, ResNet, and EfficientNet [ 4 ] . Preprocessing encompassed normalization, feature correlation analysis, and stratified partitioning, while data insufficiency was mitigated through augmentation (rotation, flipping, contrast adjustment), SMOTE, and GAN-based synthesis. Grad-CAM and SHAP were utilized for interpretability, with CNN+LSTM attaining the highest accuracy (98.2%), illustrating the efficacy of integrating spatial and sequential feature learning. Nonetheless, the study was constrained by the size of the dataset, the lack of image inputs, and diminished generalizability to clinical imaging [ 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 纳西尔等人. [2025] [15]对乳腺癌威斯康星诊断数据集(569例,33个肿瘤特征)进行了比较深入的学习分析,评估了CNN,RNN,MLP,以及混合模型(CNN+LSTM,CNN+MLP),此外还预训了VGG16,ResNet,以及高效Net[4]. 预处理包括正常化、特征相关性分析以及分层分割,而数据不足则通过增强(旋转、翻转、对比调整)、SMOTE和基于GAN的合成来缓解。 分级CAM和SHAP用于可解释性,CNN+LSTM的精度最高(98.2%),说明了将空间和相继特征学习结合起来的效果。 然而,由于数据集的大小、图像输入的缺乏以及临床成像的通用性下降[7],研究受到限制。

blocks.en: Patho-Net [ 16 ] introduced a GRU-augmented U-Net segmentation framework for breast cancer histopathology, utilizing the BreakHis dataset of 2,048 pictures at 100× magnification. The pipeline utilized Reinhard color normalization with automated reference selection, EANLM noise reduction, and I-GLCM-based feature extraction, culminating in GRU-based classification [ 3 ] . It attained an accuracy of 98.9%, precision and recall of 98.6%, and specificity of 99%, with Grad-CAM and XRAI augmenting interpretability. Notwithstanding its robust performance, the model was confined to binary classification and depended on a resource-intensive preprocessing procedure, hence limiting cross-domain generalization.
blocks.zh: Patho-Net [16] 采用了由GRU增强的U-Net分解框架,用于乳腺癌组织病理学,利用BreakHis的数据集2,048张图片在100×放大时进行. 管道采用Reinhard色调正常化,自动选择参考物,减少EANLM噪声,以及基于I-GLCM的特性提取,最终形成基于GRU的分类[3]. 它的精度达到98.9%,精度和召回率为98.6%,特异性达到99%,Grad-CAM和XRAI增强了可解释性。 该模式尽管表现良好,但仅限于二进制分类,并依赖资源密集型预处理程序,因此限制了跨领域通用。

blocks.en: Kabir et al. [2025] [ 17 ] introduced a deep learning framework for the classification of breast cancer utilizing the BUSI ultrasound dataset, which comprises 780 pictures categorized as benign, malignant, and normal. Four pretrained CNNs—EfficientNetV2S, EfficientNetV2M, InceptionResNetV2, and XceptionNet [ 1 ] were fine-tuned utilizing scaling, flipping, rotation, zooming, and stratified splitting techniques. To enhance interpretability, Faster Score-CAM and LIME were utilized, emphasizing critical diagnostic areas. EfficientNetV2S attained superior performance (91.02% accuracy, precision 0.92, recall 0.91, F1-score 0.91); however, dataset size, class imbalance, and absence of external validation limited generalizability [ 18 ] .
blocks.zh: Kabir等人 [2025] [17] 利用BUSI超声波数据集引入了乳腺癌分类深层学习框架,该数据集包含780张被归类为良性、恶性和正常的图片。 已利用缩放、翻转、旋转、缩放和分层拆分技术对四套预先训练过的CNN-EfficientNetV2S、高效率NetV2M、IncepionResNetV2和XceptionNet[1]进行了微调。 为了提高可解释性,采用了更快的分数CAM和LIME,强调关键的诊断领域。 高效NetV2S取得了优异的性能(91.02%的精度,精度0.92,召回0.91,F1-分数0.91);然而,数据集大小,阶级失衡,缺乏外部验证的有限通用性[18].

blocks.en: Talukder [2025] [ 19 ] proposed an improved DenseNet169 model for breast cancer histopathology, validated on the BreakHis (40×–400×), BACH, and BHI datasets. Preprocessing encompassed resizing (256×256), sharpening, normalization, and label encoding, along with augmentation by ±20° rotation, shifting, and flipping. Class Activation Mapping (CAM) and saliency maps were utilized for interpretability. The model attained 99.5% accuracy on BreakHis 40×, 98.8% on 100×, 97.3% on 200×, 96.9% on 400×, 94.8% on BACH, and 88% on BHI; nonetheless, difficulties remained in categorizing benign cases at elevated magnifications, highlighting the necessity for clinical validation.
blocks.zh: Talukder [2025] [19] 提出了改进后的DenseNet169乳腺癌组织病理学模型,在BreakHis(40×–400×),BACH,和BHI数据集上验证. 预处理包括重新定型(256x256)、变尖、正常化和标签编码,以及增加±20°旋转、转动和翻转。 使用类激活绘图和显要地图进行解释。 该模型在BreakHis 40x、98.8%在100x、97.3%在200x、96.9%在400x、94.8%在BACH和88%在BHI上达到准确度;然而,在提升放大度时对良性病例进行分类仍有困难,这突出表明临床验证的必要性。

blocks.en: Sharmi et al. [2025] [ 20 ] proposed an explainable framework for breast cancer diagnosis utilizing thermal images from the DMR dataset, comprising 2,010 samples. The pipeline integrated Attention U-Net for segmentation, K-Means clustering for region extraction, and EfficientNet-B7 for classification, incorporating preprocessing processes such as resizing (224×224), masking, and array conversion [ 5 ] . LIME was utilized for interpretability based on superpixels. The model attained a training accuracy of 96.5%, a validation accuracy of 91.7%, a recall of 91.9%, a specificity of 91.4%, a precision of 89.9%, and an F1-score of 90.9%. However, its generalizability was constrained by class imbalance, demographic bias, and insufficient cross-validation [ 12 ] .
blocks.zh: Shari等人[2025][20]提出了利用来自DMR数据集的热图像进行乳腺癌诊断的可解释框架,由2,010个样本组成. 管道集成的注意U-Net用于分块,K-Means集成用于区域提取,以及高效Net-B7用于分类,其中包含重排大小(224×224),遮盖,阵列转换等预处理过程[5]. LIME被用于基于超像素的可解释性. 该模型的训练精度为96.5%,验证精度为91.7%,召回精度为91.9%,特异性为91.4%,精度为89.9%,F1-分数为90.9%。 然而,由于阶级失衡、人口偏差和交叉验证不足,其普遍性受到限制[12]。

blocks.en: An ensemble-based transfer learning method [ 21 ] for breast cancer diagnosis utilizing ultrasound imagery was presented in IEEE Access [2024]. The research employed a dataset including 780 photos classified into benign, malignant, and normal categories, obtained from UCI and Kaggle. The authors employed an ensemble stacking technique to improve classification, integrating pretrained CNNs (InceptionV3, VGG16, VGG19) with machine learning classifiers, including MLPs and SVMs [ 8 ] . Preprocessing encompassed resizing, cropping, normalization, and data supplementation to enhance image quality and model resilience. The optimal ensemble model, utilizing InceptionV3 with stacking, attained an accuracy of 85.77% and an AUC of 0.947, underscoring its diagnostic efficacy [ 22 ] . Nonetheless, the approach failed to incorporate explainable AI (XAI) methodologies such as Grad-CAM or SHAP, which are essential for clinical transparency, and its scalability to extensive, heterogeneous ultrasound datasets has yet to be investigated [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 在IEEE Access [2024]中介绍了利用超声波图像诊断乳腺癌的综艺转移学习方法[21]。 研究采用了一个数据集,其中包括从UCI和Kaggle获得的780张照片,分为良性、恶性和正常类别。 作者使用综艺堆叠技术来改进分类,将预先训练的CNN(InceptionV3,VGG16,VGG19)与机器学习分类器,包括MLPs和SVMs[8]. 预处理包括重新定型、裁剪、正常化和数据补充,以提高图像质量和模型复原力。 最佳综艺模型利用可叠加的IncepionV3,精度达到85.77%,AUC达到0.947,强调其诊断效果[22]. 尽管如此,该方法没有纳入解释性AI(AI)方法,如Grad-CAM或SHAP,这些方法对于临床透明度至关重要,其可扩展性与广泛、多样的超声波数据集尚有待研究[9]。

blocks.en: Although substantial advancements have been made in deep learning for breast cancer classification, current research frequently prioritizes accuracy over interpretability, so limiting medical applicability. The integration of XAI approaches (e.g., Grad-CAM, LIME, SHAP) is superficial and inconsistent among architectures, while dependence on a singular dataset limits generalizability. Histopathology datasets, like BreakHis and BACH, exhibit class imbalance, while mammography datasets such as CBIS-DDSM and INbreast are inadequately employed for cross-model comparisons. Moreover, there is a paucity of benchmarks involving both CNNs and transformer-based models (ResNet, EfficientNet, MobileNet, Xception, ViT, Swin Transformer), and the synergistic impact of augmentation and preprocessing on interpretability remains little examined. This study fills these gaps by doing a thorough assessment of transfer learning models utilizing several XAI methodologies to establish a transparent, precise, and clinically dependable diagnostic framework.
blocks.zh: 虽然在乳腺癌分类的深入学习方面取得了很大进展,但目前的研究往往把准确性放在优先位置,而不是可解释性,从而限制了医学的适用性。 XAI方法的整合(如Grad-CAM,LIME,SHAP)在架构中表面和不一致,而依赖单数数据集则限制了通用性. 历史病理学数据集,如BreakHis和BACH,表现出阶级不平衡,而乳房X光学数据集,如CBIS-DDSM和INBreast,则没有充分用于跨模型比较. 此外,有线电视新闻网和基于变压器的模型(ResNet、高效率网、移动网、Xception、VIT、Swin变压器)的基准很少,而扩增和预处理对可解释性的协同影响几乎没有研究。 这项研究通过对转移学习模式进行彻底评估,利用若干XAI方法,建立一个透明、准确和临床上可靠的诊断框架,弥补了这些差距。

blocks.en: In this paper, we will use the BreakHis (Breast Cancer Histopathological Image Classification) dataset which is one of the most popular benchmarks of 7,909 images of 82 patients with 40, 100, 200, and 400 magnifications of both benign and malignant tumor cells. In order to guarantee methodological rigor and prevent data leakage, a patient-level strict splitting strategy was utilized, and pictures of a patient were only used in training (70%), validation (20%), or testing (10%) sets, which ensured that no overlap occurred between splits and simulated clinical conditions in real-life. The data has an inherent imbalance of classes and this was overcome by using weighted sampling methodology in training. All the images were subjected to a standardized processing procedure that included resizing (224x224 or 299x299 based on the needs of the model), ImageNet normalization, and augmentation as rotation, flipping, zooming, and contrast adjustment to enhance generalization. Also, evaluations of the magnification specifics were performed to measure the robustness of various magnifications of images. In spite of these measures, there can still be intra-patient and inter-magnification similarities in the dataset, thus, can bring subtle correlations, this is a limitation that is noted in order to make the results transparently reported and carefully interpreted.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们将使用BreakHis(Breast Cancer Histophology Image Classical)数据集,该数据集是82位患者的7,909幅图像最受欢迎的基准之一,其中40、100、200和400张放大的良性肿瘤细胞和恶性肿瘤细胞。 为了保证方法的严谨和防止数据泄露,采用了患者一级严格的分片策略,患者的照片只用于培训(70%)、验证(20%)或测试(10%)套,这确保了分片和模拟临床条件在现实生活中不会发生重叠。 数据在班级上存在固有的不平衡,在培训中使用加权抽样方法克服了这种情况。 所有图像都经过了一个标准化的处理程序,其中包括根据模型的需要重新调整大小(224x224或299x299),ImageNet正常化,以及作为旋转、翻转、放大和对比调整的增强,以加强一般化。 此外,还对放大特性进行了评价,以衡量各种图像放大的强度。 尽管采取了这些措施,但数据集中仍然存在病人内部和放大之间的相似性,因此,可以带来微妙的关联性,这是一个限制因素,已注意到这一点,以便透明地报告并仔细解释结果。

blocks.en: This study utilizes customized data augmentation techniques to enhance generalization and reduce overfitting in deep learning models for breast cancer classification, addressing the lack of labeled medical images and class imbalance [ 23 ] . Augmentations have been proposed to maintain diagnostic integrity while improving robustness: rotation (±20°) to establish rotational invariance, horizontal/vertical flipping to enhance spatial diversity [ 3 ] , shearing to replicate distortions from scanning or tissue preparation, zooming (±20%) to represent scale variations across magnifications [ 23 ] ., and contrast adjustment to accommodate discrepancies in staining and lighting conditions [ 24 ] . Bilinear interpolation was employed during scaling and translating to maintain smooth transitions and reduce aliasing problems [ 12 ] . These augmentations collectively mimic real-world variability, allowing models to learn invariant, clinically significant characteristics that enhance classification performance across various imaging settings.
blocks.zh: 这项研究利用定制数据增强技术,加强乳腺癌分类的普及,减少在深层学习模型中的过度适应,解决缺乏标签的医疗图像和班级不平衡问题[23]. 已提出加强措施,以保持诊断完整性,同时提高稳健性:旋转(±20°)确定旋转偏移,水平/垂直翻转,以增强空间多样性[3],剪切以复制扫描或组织准备过程中的扭曲,放大(±20%)以表示放大度的尺度变化[23].,对比调整以适应污损和照明条件的差异[24]. 在缩放和翻译过程中采用了双线插值,以保持平稳过渡并减少别名问题[12]. 这些增强物共同模仿现实世界的变异性,使模型能够学习变化无常,临床上重要的特征,增强不同成像环境的分类性能.

blocks.en: Transfer learning has become a potent approach in medical image analysis, especially in contexts with scarce labelled data. Transfer learning utilises deep neural networks pretrained on extensive datasets like ImageNet to generate robust, generalisable characteristics that may be refined for specific applications, such as breast cancer prediction. This work utilised many advanced pretrained models, including ResNet, VGG, DenseNet, EfficientNet, Xception, MobileNet, and vision transformer architectures, to evaluate their efficacy in breast cancer detection and classification. The models were modified by substituting their final classification layers and fine-tuning specific layers on target datasets to enhance performance for the particular diagnostic task.
blocks.zh: 转让学习已成为医学图像分析的有力方法,特别是在缺乏标签数据的情况下。 转移学习利用像ImageNet这样的广泛数据集预先训练的深层神经网络,产生强健的、可通用的特性,这些特性可以用于特定应用,如乳腺癌预测。 这项工作利用了许多经过预先培训的先进模型,包括ResNet、VGG、DenseNet、高效率网络、Xception、MobileNet和视觉变压器架构,评估它们在乳腺癌检测和分类方面的功效。 这些模型通过替换其最终分类层和在目标数据集上微调特定层来进行修改,以提高特定诊断任务的性能.

blocks.en: This study utilized DenseNet-121, a densely connected convolutional neural network pre-trained on ImageNet, as the foundation for classifying breast cancer histopathology images. The architecture utilizes extensive connectivity, allowing each layer to receive inputs from all prior levels, thus enhancing gradient flow, optimizing parameter efficiency, and alleviating vanishing gradient problems. The backbone consists of four dense blocks (6, 12, 24, and 16 layers, growth rate = 32) interspersed with transition layers utilizing 1×1 convolutions and 2×2 average pooling, culminating in global average pooling [ 25 ] , [ 26 ] . A bespoke classifier head was incorporated, comprising a fully connected layer (1024→512) with ReLU activation, dropout (p=0.5) for regularization, and a concluding dense layer (512→2) generating logits for binary classification (benign versus malignant) [ 2 ] . Input photos were downsized to 224×224, normalized, then augmented by random rotations, shifts, scaling, and flips to improve generality. The model underwent fine-tuning utilizing Label Smoothing Cross-Entropy loss ( ε \varepsilon =0.1), optimized via AdamW (weight decay = 0.01) with differential learning rates, and trained employing Cosine Annealing Warm Restarts [ 25 ] , [ 26 ] . Supplementary regularization encompassed RandAugment and gradual layer unfreezing. Training was conducted with a batch size of 32 over 50 epochs, incorporating early stopping (patience = 15, monitored on validation F1-score).
blocks.zh: 这项研究利用了DenseNet-121,这是一个在ImageNet上预先训练的密集的神经网络,作为乳腺癌组织病理学图像分类的基础. 该架构利用了广泛的连通性,使每一层都能够接收以前所有各级的投入,从而提高梯度流量,优化参数效率,并缓解逐渐消失的梯度问题。 骨干由四个密集区块(6,12,24,和16层,生长速率=32)组成,过渡区层使用1×1转盘和2×2平均集合,最终形成全球平均集合[25],[26]. 采用了一个点名分类器头,包括一个完全连接的层(1024 – 512),用于ReLU激活,用于规范化的退出(p=0.5),以及一个最终密集层(512 – 2),生成二进制分类的对数(对恶)[2]。 输入照片缩小到224×224,正常化,然后通过随机旋转,转向,缩放,翻转来增强通俗性. 该模型利用Label平滑交叉进取损失(\\\varepsilon=0.1)进行了微调,通过AdamW(重量衰减=0.01)进行优化,学习率有差异,并培训了Cosine Annaling Warm Restarts[25],[26]。 补充正规化包括加强和逐步解冻。 培训的批量规模为32个50个世纪以上,包括早期停止(patience = 15,经验证F1-分数监测)。

blocks.en: This study utilized EfficientNet, a scalable convolutional neural network created by Google AI, owing to its exceptional balance between accuracy and computational efficiency in medical image classification [ 10 ] , [ 27 ] . The model uses the compound scaling method, which uniformly adjusts network depth, width, and input resolution, and is constructed using MBConv (Mobile Inverted Residual Bottleneck) blocks integrated with squeeze-and-excitation (SE) modules for channel-wise recalibration. We specifically fine-tuned EfficientNet-B0 and its larger variants (EfficientNetV2S and EfficientNet-B7), which were pretrained on ImageNet, by substituting the classifier head with a bespoke binary classification architecture [ 28 ] . The backbone generated 1280 feature maps, which underwent global average pooling, succeeded by dropout (p = 0.5), a fully connected layer (1280 → 512, ReLU), an additional dropout, and a concluding linear layer (512 → 2) to yield logits for benign and malignant classifications. The training utilized Cross Entropy Loss with label smoothing and softmax activation during inference. To mitigate overfitting and enhance resilience, input photos were downsized (224×224 or 380×380), normalized, and subjected to augmentation by random flipping, zooming, shifting, and rotation with Keras’ ImageDataGenerator [ 28 ] . The model underwent training with a progressive unfreezing of the pretrained backbone and varying learning rates, resulting in roughly 4 million trainable parameters post fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 由于医学图像分类的精度和计算效率之间的特殊平衡[10],[27]. 该模型采用复合缩放法,统一调整网络深度,宽度和输入分辨率,采用MBConv(Mobile Invertioned Relected Bottleneck)区块与挤-引(SE)模块结合构建,用于信道重排. 我们特别微调了高效网-B0及其更大的变体(EfficentNetV2S和高效网-B7),这些变体在ImageNet上经过了预先的训练,将分类器头替换为标语二进制分类架构[28]. 骨干生成了1 280个特征图,经历了全球平均集合,其成功之处是辍学(p=0.5)、一个完全连接的层(1280 = 512、ReLU)、另一个辍学,以及一个最终的线性层(512 = 2),以得出良性和恶性分类的对数。 该培训利用了Cross Entropy Loss,在推论中带有标签平滑和软马克斯激活. 为了减轻过度适应和增强复原力,输入照片缩小了(224x224或380x380),实现了正常化,并与Keras的图像数据采集器进行了随机翻转、缩放、移动和旋转,从而进行了增强。 该模式接受了培训,对预先培训的骨干进行了逐步解冻,学习率也各不相同,因此在微调后约有400万个可培训参数。

blocks.en: Using the BreakHis dataset, we optimized ConvNeXt, a state-of-the-art CNN architecture that draws inspiration from ResNet and Vision Transformers, for the purpose of breast cancer histological picture categorization. ConvNeXt maintains CNN inductive biases, such as locality and translation equivariance, while integrating transformer-inspired design elements, including extensive kernel depthwise convolutions, inverted bottlenecks, Layer Normalization, GELU activation, stochastic depth, AdamW optimization, and cosine learning rate scheduling [ 29 ] , [ 30 ] . We employed the ConvNeXt-Tiny/Base variation pretrained on ImageNet-21k and substituted the classification head with a bespoke architecture using LayerNorm, GELU activation, dropout (p=0.5), and fully connected layers (768 → 512 → 2) for the binary classification of benign and malignant instances. Input photos were reduced to 224×224 pixels, normalized with ImageNet statistics, and augmented by RandAugment (n=2, m=10), random cropping, color jittering, flipping, and rotation, while test-time augmentation (TTA) was utilized for enhanced inference robustness [ 30 ] . Training utilized label-smoothing cross-entropy (smoothing=0.1), the AdamW optimizer (weight decay=0.01), cosine annealing for learning rate scheduling, and mixed-precision training, alongside a gradual unfreezing of backbone layers to modify pretrained features [ 31 ] . The model comprised around 28.6 million trainable parameters.
blocks.zh: 利用BreakHis的数据集,我们优化了ConvNEXt,这是CNN最先进的架构,从ResNet和Vision Transformers中汲取灵感,用于乳腺癌组织图谱分类. ConvNEXt维持有线电视新闻网的诱导偏差,如位置和翻译等效,同时整合变压器启发设计元素,包括广泛的内核深度演化,逆向瓶颈,层态化,GELU激活,线粒体深度,AdamW优化,以及余弦学习速率排程[29],[30]. 我们使用了在ImageNet-213上预先训练的ConvNEXt-Tiny/Base变异,并用标语结构取代了分类头,使用LetleNorm、GELU激活、退出(p=0.5)和完全连接的层(768~512~2)来进行良性和恶性的二进制分类。 输入照片被减少到224×224像素,与ImageNet统计正常化,并被RandAugment(n=2,m=10)所扩充,随机裁剪,调色,翻转和旋转,而测试时间增强(TTA)则用于增强推论强度[30]. 培训利用了标签吸附式交叉吸附(smoothing=0.1),AdamW优化器(重量衰减=0.01),用于学习速度排程的余弦反射,以及混合精度培训,同时逐步解冻骨干层,以修改预先训练的特性[31]. 该模型包括约2 860万个可培训参数。

blocks.en: This study utilized the fine-tuning of a ResNet-50 backbone, pretrained on ImageNet, for the classification of breast cancer utilizing the BreaKHis dataset. The input photos were downsized to 224×224 RGB, normalized using ImageNet statistics, and augmented by flipping, rotation, zooming, and RandAugment [ 32 ] . The backbone (about 23.5 million parameters) was initially fixed and subsequently unfixed with varying learning rates, while the custom classifier head (approximately 1.05 million parameters) comprised fully connected layers of 2048→512→2 with ReLU activation and a dropout rate of 0.5 [ 33 ] . The training employed CrossEntropyLoss with label smoothing, the Adam optimizer, and cosine annealing with warm restarts, while the assessment metrics comprised accuracy, precision, recall, specificity, F1-score, and AUC-ROC [ 32 ] . To improve interpretability, Grad-CAM, LIME, SHAP, and LRP were combined for visualizing decision boundaries.
blocks.zh: 这项研究利用ResNet-50主干线的微调,利用BreaKHis数据集,在ImageNet上进行了预先培训,对乳腺癌进行分类。 输入照片缩小为224×224 RGB,通过ImageNet统计实现常态化,并通过翻转,旋转,缩放,和RandAugment[32]进行扩充. 骨干(约2,350万个参数)最初是固定的,后来没有固定,学习率各异,而定制分类器头(约105万个参数)则由2048–512–2的全连接层组成,ReLU激活,辍学率为0.5[33]. 培训采用CrossEntropyLoss,标签为平滑、Adam优化器、Cosine Annealing和温暖重启,而评估指标包括准确性、精确性、回忆性、特异性、F1-分数和AUC-ROC[32]。 为了提高可解释性,将Grad-CAM、LIME、SHAP和LRP结合起来,可视化决定界限。

blocks.en: The study used InceptionV3, a deep convolutional neural network architecture designed for effective multi-scale feature extraction, as a transfer learning model for breast cancer classification [ 34 ] . InceptionV3 enhances the original GoogLeNet by integrating factorized convolutions, auxiliary classifiers, asymmetric filters (1×7 and 7×1), and batch normalization, hence facilitating computational efficiency and superior generalization. The model employs Inception modules that concurrently process various convolution filters (1×1, 3×3, 5×5), effectively capturing both local and global representations [ 1 ] . In our approach, the pretrained backbone was initialized using ImageNet weights, and the final classification head was substituted with a dense block (2048→512→2) with ReLU activation and dropout (p=0.5), in addition to a modified auxiliary classifier. Histopathology photos were downsized to 299×299, normalized using ImageNet statistics, and augmented with RandAugment, including cropping, flipping, rotating, zooming, and color jittering [ 34 ] . Training utilized the AdamW optimizer, label smoothing cross-entropy, cosine annealing warm restarts, mixed precision, and a gradual unfreezing of backbone layers for stable fine-tuning [ 1 ] .
blocks.zh: 研究使用InceptionV3,一种为有效多尺度特征提取而设计的深演神经网络架构,作为乳腺癌分类的转录学习模型[34]. 诱导 V3通过集成因子化的演化器,辅助分类器,不对称滤波器(1×7和7×1)和批量正常化来增强原GoogleNet,从而促进计算效率和优异的概括. 该模型采用了Inception模块,同时处理各种演化滤波器(1×1,3×3,5×5),有效捕捉到当地和全球的表示[1]. 在我们的方法中,预先训练的骨干是使用ImageNet权重初始化的,最后的分类头被一个密集的块(2048–512–2)替换为ReLU激活和淘汰(p=0.5),此外还有经过修改的辅助分类器. 历史病理学照片缩小到299x299, 使用ImageNet统计实现正常化, 并增加了RandAugment, 包括裁剪、翻转、旋转、放大和彩色抖动[34]。 训练使用亚当W优化器,标注平滑的跨直径,余弦反射的温暖重启,混合精度,并逐渐解冻骨干层以进行稳定的微调[1].

blocks.en: This research used VGG-19, pretrained on ImageNet, as a transfer learning model for the classification of breast cancer. The backbone, consisting of 16 convolutional and 5 pooling layers (about 20 million parameters), was initially frozen and subsequently fine-tuned using differential learning rates and a gradual unfreezing approach [ 35 ] . The initial head was substituted with a bespoke classifier ( 102.8M parameters) comprising Linear (25088→4096→4096→512→2) layers, ReLU activations, and several dropout layers (p=0.5) for regularization purposes. The input photos were downsized to 224×224, normalized, and augmented using RandAugment, along with cropping, flipping, rotation, and color jittering [ 10 ] . The training employed Label Smoothing Cross-Entropy (smoothing=0.1), the AdamW optimizer, cosine annealing warm restarts, AMP mixed-precision, and early halting, resulting in about 122.8 million trainable parameters optimized for histopathology picture classification [ 35 ] .
blocks.zh: 这一研究使用在ImageNet上预训的VGG-19作为乳腺癌分类的转移学习模型. 骨干由16个转式层和5个集合层(约2,000万个参数)组成,最初被冻结,之后采用差别学习率和逐渐解冻的方法进行微调[35]. 初始头改为标语分类器(102.8M参数),由线性(25088_4096_4096_512_2)层、ReLU激活层和几个退出层(p=0.5)组成,用于规范化目的。 输入照片缩小到224×224, 规范化, 并使用 RandAugment 进行加固, 同时进行裁剪、翻转、旋转和彩色抖动[10] 。 训练采用Label滑行跨Entropy(smoothing=0.1),AdamW优化器,余弦反射热重启,AMP混合精度,以及早期停止,导致约1.228亿个可训练参数被优化用于组织病理学图片分类[35].

blocks.en: This research utilized MobileNetV2, a lightweight convolutional neural network optimized for processing efficiency by depthwise separable convolutions and inverted residual bottlenecks with linear projections [ 31 ] . The model accepts 224×224 RGB inputs, commencing with a 3×3 convolution (32 filters, stride 2), succeeded by a series of 17 bottleneck layers incorporating expansion through 1×1 convolutions, depthwise filtering, and projection layers. Each block integrates ReLU6 activations and residual shortcuts when the input and output dimensions are congruent [ 1 ] . The backbone generates 1280 feature maps, which are subsequently processed by a global average pooling layer and a bespoke classifier head (Linear 1280→512, ReLU, Dropout 0.5, Linear 512→2) for binary classification. MobileNetV2, with around 3.5 million parameters, attains a balance between precision and low complexity, rendering it appropriate for medical imaging applications where efficiency and scalability are paramount [ 36 ] , [ 24 ] .
blocks.zh: 这项研究利用了MobileNetV2,一个轻量级的转录神经网络,通过深度可分离的转录和线性预测的逆向剩余瓶颈优化处理效率[31]. 该型号接受224×224 RGB输入,开始为3×3转式(32个滤波器,2步),通过1×1转式,深度滤波器,投影层等一系列17个瓶颈层结合扩张而成功. 每个块在输入和输出维度一致[1]时将ReLU6激活和剩余快捷键整合. 骨干生成1280个特征图,随后由全球平均集合层和一个铃声分类头(Linear 1280–512,ReLU,Dropout 0.5,Linear 512–2)进行二进制分类处理. MobileNetV2有大约350万个参数,在精度和低复杂性之间取得平衡,使之适用于高效和可伸缩性至高无上的医学成像应用[36],[24]。

blocks.en: This study utilized a Vision Transformer (ViT-B/16) pretrained on ImageNet-21k and subsequently fine-tuned for breast cancer categorization [ 37 ] . Input images (3×224×224) were segmented into 16×16 non-overlapping patches, resulting in 196 tokens embedded in 768-dimensional vectors, together with an additional learnable class token and positional embeddings [ 38 ] . The sequence underwent processing through 12 transformer encoder blocks, each consisting of multi-head self-attention (12 heads), MLP layers (hidden=3072, GELU), LayerNorm, residual connections, and dropout (p=0.1). The ultimate representation underwent LayerNorm, followed by a bespoke classifier head incorporating LayerNorm, Linear (768→512), GELU, Dropout, and Linear (512→2) for binary classification [ 39 ] . The architecture comprised over 86 million parameters, with around 400,000 derived from the custom head, facilitating efficient fine-tuning on histopathological pictures while maintaining the ViT’s robust feature extraction and contextual modeling abilities [ 36 ] , [ 40 ] .
blocks.zh: 这项研究使用了在ImageNet-213k上预先训练的视觉变形器(ViT-B/16),随后对乳腺癌分类进行了微调[37]。 输入图像(3×224×224)被分解为16×16非重叠补丁,导致嵌入768维向量的196个符号,加上额外的可学习的类符号和位置嵌入[38]. 序列经过12个变压器编码器块的处理,每个块由多头自留(12个头),MLP层(隐藏=3072,GELU),LayerNorm,剩余连接,以及退出(p=0.1)组成. 最终的表示方式是TyleNorm,然后是包含TyleNorm, Linear(768–512), GELU, Dropout, and Linear(512–2)二进制分类的标语分类头[39]. 该建筑由8 600多万个参数组成,大约40万个参数来自定制头,有利于对组织病理学图片进行高效的微调,同时保持ViT的强健特征提取和背景建模能力[36],[40]。
4.3.9 (中文(简体) ). Swin 变形器 (屏蔽窗口变形器)

blocks.en: This research used the Swin Transformer Tiny, a hierarchical vision transformer pretrained on ImageNet-1K, for the classification of breast cancer images [ 41 ] , [ 40 ] . Input images (3×224×224) were divided into 4×4 patches and transformed into 768-dimensional tokens, which underwent four steps of shifted window-based multi-head self-attention (W-MSA, SW-MSA), residual connections, LayerNorm, and MLPs with GELU activations. Patch merging systematically diminished resolution while augmenting channel depth (768→1536→3072) [ 41 ] . The backbone output, a 3072-dimensional feature vector, was consolidated using global average pooling and forwarded to a bespoke classifier head consisting of Linear (768→512), ReLU, Dropout (0.5), Linear (512→256), ReLU, Dropout (0.5), and Linear (256→2) for the prediction of benign versus malignant outcomes [ 29 ] . The architecture had approximately 28.3 million parameters, with around 0.5 million being trainable during the initial fine-tuning phase, integrating transformer-based global context modeling with computational efficiency appropriate for high-resolution medical imaging [ 29 ] .
blocks.zh: 这项研究使用了Swin Transformer Tiny,一种在ImageNet-1K上预先训练的分级视觉变压器,用于乳腺癌图像的分类[41],[40]. 输入图像(3×224×224)被分为4×4补丁,转换为768维的符号,它经历了四步转向的基于窗口的多头自留(W-MSA,SW-MSA),剩余连接,LayerNorm,以及带有GELU激活的MLP. 补丁合并系统降低分辨率,同时扩大信道深度(768_1536_3072)[41]。 骨干产出是3072维特性矢量,采用全球平均集合法加以合并,并传送到由Linear(768–512)、ReLU、Dropout(0.5)、Linear(512–256)、ReLU、Dropout(0.5)和Linear(256–2)组成的标定分类头,用于预测良性结果与恶性结果[29]。 该建筑约有2,830万个参数,其中约50万个在最初的微调阶段可以训练,将基于变压器的全球背景模型与高分辨率医学成像的计算效率相结合[29].

blocks.en: The study utilized Xception (Extreme Inception), a deep convolutional neural network pretrained on ImageNet, modified for binary breast cancer classification [ 16 ] . Xception substitutes conventional convolutions with depthwise separable convolutions integrated with residual connections, facilitating efficient feature extraction. The network processes 299×299 RGB inputs via an entering flow of convolutional and separable convolutional layers (32–728 channels), succeeded by a middle flow including 8 repeating blocks (728 channels), and concluding with an exit flow that expands to 2048 channels [ 42 ] . The backbone output undergoes global average pooling, dropout (p=0.5), and a concluding linear layer (2048→2) for the classification of benign and malignant cases. The training utilized the AdamW optimizer, cosine annealing warm restarts, and label-smoothed cross-entropy loss, rendering the model both computationally efficient and highly expressive for histopathology picture processing [ 31 ] .
blocks.zh: 研究使用了Xocepion(Extreme Inception),一个在ImageNet上预先训练的深层进化神经网络,为二元乳腺癌分类而修改[16]. Xception 取代了常规的切变,其深度可分离的切变与剩余连接结合,有利于高效的特征提取. 网络处理299×299 RGB输入通过进流的进流的转录层和可分离的转录层(32–728通道),由包括8个重复块(728通道)在内的中间流继而完成,最后通过扩大至2048通道[42]的出流. 骨干产出通过全球平均集合、辍学(p=0.5)和最终线性层(2048/2)进行良性和恶性病例分类。 培训利用了AdamW优化器,余弦反射热复发,以及标注的反射损失,使模型在计算效率上和在组织病理学图片处理上都具有高度的表达力[31].

blocks.en: The black-box aspect of deep learning models presents major obstacles to their clinical adoption, where trust and transparency are of the utmost importance, notwithstanding their impressive accuracy in breast cancer detection. Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) methodologies seek to mitigate this constraint by offering human-comprehensible insights into model predictions [ 43 ] . This study utilised XAI technologies, including Grad-CAM, LIME, SHAP, and XRAI, to visualise and elucidate the decision-making processes of diverse deep learning models. These tools not only improve model transparency but also aid doctors in verifying the regions or features most significant in diagnosis results.
blocks.zh: 深层学习模式的黑盒方面对其临床采用构成重大障碍,尽管信任和透明度在乳腺癌检测方面十分准确,但它们在临床上至关重要。 解释性人工智能(XAI)方法试图通过对模型预测提供人类可理解的洞察力来缓解这一制约因素[43]. 这项研究利用了XAI技术,包括Grad-CAM、LIME、SHAP和XRAI,来描绘和阐明各种深层学习模式的决策过程。 这些工具不仅提高了模型的透明度,而且有助于医生核实各地区或诊断结果方面最重要的特征。
4.4.1 梯级CAM (分级加权级激活绘图).

blocks.en: Grad-CAM (Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping) was utilized to improve the interpretability of deep learning models by producing class-discriminative heatmaps that emphasize the picture regions most significant for classification [ 37 , 44 ] . It calculates the gradients of the projected class score relative to the feature maps of the final convolutional layer, use global average pooling to obtain channel weights, and generates a ReLU-activated weighted sum to create the final heatmap. The heatmap is subsequently overlaid on the original image, clearly highlighting areas essential for decision-making [ 28 , 31 ] . This study employed Grad-CAM across various architectures (ResNet50, DenseNet121, Xception, EfficientNetV2, Swin Transformer) to assess the models’ attention to aberrant tissue patterns. Its post hoc nature, necessitating no architectural alterations, renders it especially appropriate for medical imaging applications where trust and transparency are important [ 29 ] .
blocks.zh: Grad-CAM(高级加权类活性绘图)被用于提高深层学习模型的可解释性,方法是制作班级差别热图,强调图景区对分类最为重要[37、44]。 它计算预测的类分数相对于最终演化层的特征图的梯度,使用全局平均集合来获得通道权重,并生成一个RELU激活的加权总和来创建最终热映射. 热图随后被覆盖在原图上,清楚地突出了决策所必需的领域[28,31]. 这项研究利用Grad-CAM跨越各种建筑(ResNet50、DenseNet121、Xception、EffectiveNetV2、Swin Transformer)来评估模型对异常组织模式的关注。 它的后期性质使得无需进行建筑改造,因此特别适合于医学成像应用,因为信任和透明度非常重要[29]。
4.4.2 液态 (当地可解释的模型-不可知解释)

blocks.en: The study used LIME (Local Interpretable Model-Agnostic Explanations) to produce localized, case-specific elucidations of breast cancer classification models. In contrast to gradient-based approaches, LIME is model-agnostic, approximating intricate predictions with a straightforward interpretable surrogate by perturbing inputs into superpixels and analyzing output fluctuations [ 9 ] . Each image underwent masking or modification, and a local linear model was applied to assess the significance of various image segments. LIME was utilized on models such as ResNet50, EfficientNet, DenseNet121, and Swin Transformer, emphasizing the areas most critical for benign or malignant predictions. This offered clear, instance-specific interpretability, augmenting Grad-CAM by elucidating local decision limits that global saliency maps would neglect, thus enhancing clinical confidence in AI-assisted breast cancer diagnosis [ 45 ] .
blocks.zh: 该研究利用LIME(当地可解释模型-不可知解释)对乳腺癌分类模型进行局部化的个案解释. 与基于梯度的方法相反,LIME是模型不可知的,近似复杂预测,通过扰动对超像素的投入和分析输出波动来直截了当地解释代词[9]. 每个图像都经过遮盖或修改,并采用了当地线性模型来评估各种图像段的重要性。 LIME被用于ResNet50、高效网、DenseNet121和Swin Transformer等模型,强调对良性或恶性预测最为关键的领域。 这提供了明确的、针对具体实例的解释性,通过阐明当地决定的限度,即全球显著性地图将被忽视,从而增强临床对AI协助的乳腺癌诊断的信心[45],增强了Grad-CAM。

blocks.en: SHAP was used to measure feature significance through principles of cooperative game theory, assigning the contribution of each input region to the model’s output. By estimating Shapley values, SHAP equitably allocates prediction influence among picture superpixels or patches [ 46 ] . This work employed SHAP on models such as ResNet50, EfficientNet, DenseNet121, and Swin Transformer, generating heatmaps that emphasized areas influencing malignant or benign predictions. In contrast to gradient-based techniques, SHAP delivers globally consistent and theoretically robust explanations, furnishing doctors with insights into the influence of each input feature on decision outcomes [ 24 ] .
blocks.zh: SHAP被用来通过合作游戏理论的原则来测量特征意义,将每个输入区对模型输出的贡献分配到其中. 通过估计Shapley值,SHAP在图片超像素或补丁之间公平分配预测影响[46]. 这项工作在ResNet50、高效网、DenseNet121和Swin Transformer等模型中使用了SHAP,生成热图,强调影响恶性或良性预测的地区。 与基于梯度的技术相反,SHAP提供全球一致和理论上强有力的解释,使医生深入了解每个投入对决策结果的影响[24]。

blocks.en: Integrated Gradients were used to attribute model predictions by calculating the path integral of gradients between a baseline (e.g., a black images) and the input image. This method offers a systematic methodology for allocating contribution scores to each pixel by averaging gradients along the interpolation trajectory [ 46 ] . This study employed IG on CNN and transformer-based architectures to elucidate subtle tissue patterns affecting benign-malignant classification. Its efficacy is rooted in generating smoother and more accurate attributions than raw gradients, rendering it particularly suitable for medical imaging, where detailed interpretability is essential [ 43 ] .
blocks.zh: 集成梯度用于通过计算基线(如黑色图像)和输入图像之间的梯度构成的路径来属性模型预测. 这种方法提供了一种系统的方法,通过沿内插轨迹的平均梯度来分配每个像素的贡献分数[46]. 这项研究利用有线电视新闻网和变压器架构的IG来阐明影响良性-恶性分类的微妙组织模式。 其功效植根于产生比原始梯度更平滑,更准确的属性,使其特别适合医学成像,而详细的可解释性是必不可少的[43].

blocks.en: LRP was utilized as a backpropagation-based explanation technique, redistributing the prediction score backwards through the network to identify the input areas that were most responsible for the decision [ 47 ] . Using relevance conservation concepts, LRP assigns pixel-level contributions that aggregate to the model’s output, producing comprehensive and intuitive visual representations. LRP was incorporated into CNNs (ResNet, DenseNet, Xception) for the analysis of breast cancer images, emphasizing significant histological features. LRP’s ability to deliver detailed pixel attributions improves clinical confidence by guaranteeing that diagnostic predictions correspond with medically relevant structures.
blocks.zh: LRP被用作一种基于反传播的解释技术,通过网络向后再分配预测得分,以确定对决定负最大责任的投入领域[47]. LRP利用相关保护概念,将像素级的贡献分配给模型的产出,产生全面和直观的视觉表现。 LRP被并入CNN(ResNet,DenseNet,Xeption),以分析乳腺癌图像,强调重要的组织特征. LRP提供详细的像素属性的能力,通过保证诊断预测与医学相关的结构相符,提高了临床信心.

blocks.en: The BreakHis dataset is a collection of histopathological pictures created by the P&D Lab in Brazil, comprising 7,909 microscopic images of breast tissue samples from 82 patients, classified as benign or malignant. Images are obtained at four magnification levels: 40X, 100X, 200X, and 400X, utilising an Olympus BX-50 microscope. The dataset has eight subtypes: four benign (adenosis, fibroadenoma, phyllodes tumour, tubular adenoma) and four malignant (ductal carcinoma, lobular carcinoma, mucinous carcinoma, papillary carcinoma). The dataset exhibits imbalance and significant intra-class variability, rendering it appropriate for training and assessing deep learning models in fine-grained classification tasks. Each image is in RGB format and possesses a resolution of 700×460 pixels.
blocks.zh: 间断 他的数据集是巴西P&D实验室制作的一组组织病理学图片,包括来自82名被归类为良性或恶性患者的7,909张乳腺组织样本的显微图像. 图像在四个放大级:40X、100X、200X和400X,使用奥林匹斯BX-50显微镜。 该数据集有8个亚型:4个良性型(腺硬化,纤维瘤,血栓瘤,管腺腺瘤)和4个恶性型(管道癌,球细胞癌,黏膜癌,石膏癌). 数据集显示出不平衡和阶级内部的显著差异,使其适合培训和评估精细分类任务的深层学习模式。 每个图像采用RGB格式,拥有700×460像素的分辨率.

blocks.en: Table 1: Performance of DenseNet-121 on the BreakHis dataset
blocks.zh: 表1:DenseNet-121在休息时的表现 他的数据集

blocks.en: DenseNet-121 performed well on the BreakHis dataset, showing the ability to generalize across magnifications. On the validation set, it achieved 89.24% accuracy, 90.72% precision, 95.46% recall, 70.31% specificity, an F1-score of 93.03%, and an AUC-ROC of 0.9362, indicating high sensitivity but some misclassification of benign cases(Table 1 & Figure 1). On the test set (at all magnifications), the model achieved near-perfect results with 99.41% accuracy, 99.86% precision, 99.45% recall, 99.17% specificity, 99.65% F1-score, and 0.9997 AUC-ROC, indicating strong generalization and balanced performance across both malignant and benign classes (Figure 2 & 3). The model reliably extracted discriminative histopathological characteristics at individual magnification settings (40X, 100X, and 200X) with 100% accuracy across all measures (Figure 4). These findings show the effectiveness of DenseNet-121’s densely connected architecture in reducing vanishing gradients, encouraging feature reuse, and providing highly reliable breast cancer classification performance on histopathology pictures.
blocks.zh: DenseNet-121在BreakHis数据集上表现优异,显示出跨放大的通用能力. 在验证中,它取得了89.24%的准确度,90.72%的精确度,95.46%的回溯率,70.31%的特异性,93.03%的F1分数,0.9362的AUC-ROC,表明对良性病例的敏感性很高,但有些分类错误(表1和图1)。 在测试组(所有放大)上,该模型以99.41%的精度、99.86%的精度、99.94%的回溯率、99.17%的特异性、99.65%的F1-分数和0.9997的AUC-ROC取得了接近完美的结果,表明在恶性和良性类别中都得到了有力的概括和平衡的表现(图2和图3)。 该模型在单个放大环境(40X、100X和200X)中可靠地提取出歧视性组织病理学特征,所有测量的准确度都达到100%(图4)。 这些调查结果表明,DenseNet-121的密集连接结构在降低消亡梯度、鼓励特征再利用以及在组织病理学图片上提供高度可靠的乳腺癌分类性能方面是有效的。

blocks.zh: 表 2: 中断时高效网络的运行情况 他的数据集

blocks.en: On the BreakHis dataset, EfficientNet performed well though with a little bit of variation. With a recall of 94.31%, a specificity of 89.74%, an F1-score of 95.18%, and an area under the curve (AUC-ROC) of 0.979 on the validation set (at all magnifications), it demonstrated strong generalizability and a balanced sensitivity-specificity trade-off (Table 2). Nevertheless, a decline in performance to 86.16% accuracy, 83.6% precision, 85.99% recall, 86.29% specificity, 84.78% F1-score, and 0.9397 AUC-ROC was seen on the test set (at all magnifications), indicating difficulties with generalization (Figure 5). 40X (85.9% accuracy, 94.64% AUC), 100X (86.27% accuracy, 94.13% AUC), 200X (85.52% accuracy, 95.87% AUC), and 400X (84.28% accuracy, 91.5% AUC) were all results that were consistent but below validation (Figure 6 & 7). These results demonstrate that EfficientNet is efficient and has good feature extraction capabilities, but they also show that it is sensitive to variance in magnification and that test performance is slightly lower than validation (Figure 8). This suggests that there may be overfitting in this dataset and that more optimization is needed.
blocks.zh: 在休息时 他的数据集,“高效网络”虽然有一点变化,但表现良好。 它的召回率为94.31%,特异性为89.74%,F1-分数为95.18%,曲线(AUC-ROC)下面积为0.979,在验证组(总放大度)上,它显示出强烈的可通用性以及平衡的敏感性特异性权衡(表2)。 尽管如此,在测试集(图5)上,性能下降至86.16%准确度,83.6%精度,85.99%回溯率,86.29%精度,84.78%F1-分数,以及0.9397AUC-ROC,表明在通用化方面存在困难(图5)40X(85.9%精度,94.64%AUC),100X(86.27%精度,94.13%AUC),200X(85.52%精度,95.87%AUC)和400X(84.28%精度,91.5%AUC)都是一致但低于验证值的结果(图6和7)。 这些结果显示,效率网是高效率的,具有良好的特性提取能力,但也表明其对放大差异敏感,测试性能略低于验证(图8)。 这表明本数据集可能过于吻合,需要更加优化.

blocks.en: Table 3: Performance of ConvNeXt on the BreakHis dataset
blocks.zh: 表3:ConvNEXt在休息时间的表现 他的数据集

blocks.en: ConvNeXt showed moderate efficacy on the BreakHis dataset, with the validation set achieving 80.92% accuracy, 80.62% precision, 91.14% recall, 64.23% specificity, 85.56% F1-score, and 0.8806 AUC-ROC, indicating strong sensitivity but a diminished capacity to accurately detect benign instances (Table 3). In the test set (across all magnifications), the results exhibited a fall to 77.14% accuracy, 85.12% precision, 89.06% recall, 2.42% specificity, 87.04% F1-score, and 0.6533 AUC-ROC, indicating a pronounced bias towards malignant categorization owing to the exceedingly low specificity (Figure 9, 10 & 11)). ConvNeXt showed consistently high recall ( ≥ \geq .88%) across various magnifications but had inadequate specificity, especially at 40X (0%) and only slight enhancements at 100X (2.7%), 200X (8.7%), and 400X (3.45%), despite F1-scores ranging from 86% to 88% (Figure 12). The results indicate that although ConvNeXt effectively detects malignant samples owing to its hierarchical convolutional-transformer hybrid architecture, its failure to balance false positives undermines its diagnostic reliability in breast cancer classification.
blocks.zh: ConvNEXt在BreakHis数据集上表现出了中等的功效,验证集达到了80.92%的精度,80.62%的精度,91.14%的回顾,64.23%的特异性,85.56%的F1分,以及0.8806的AUC-ROC,这表明强烈的敏感性,但准确检测良性事件的能力减弱(表3). 在测试组(包括所有放大)中,结果显示精度下降至77.14%,精度下降85.12%,召回率下降89.06%,特异性下降2.42%,F1-分数上升87.04%,AUC-ROC下降0.6533,这表明由于特异性极低,明显偏向恶性分类(图9、10和11))。 尽管F1分数从86%到88%不等(图12),但ConvNEXt在各种放大中始终表现出很高的召回率(X\geq.88%),但具体性不强,特别是在40X(0%),在100X(2.7%)、200X(8.7%)和400X(3.45%),只有微小增强。 结果显示,虽然ConvNEXt由于其分级的转录-转录杂交结构,有效检测恶性样本,但其未能平衡假阳性,损害了其在乳腺癌分类中的诊断可靠性.

blocks.en: Table 4: Performance of InceptionV3 on the BreakHis dataset
blocks.zh: 表4:休眠时受体V3的性能 他的数据集

blocks.en: Inception V3 showed strong results on the BreakHis validation set, achieving 94.29% accuracy, 96.22% precision, 95.91% recall, 89.96% specificity, 96.06% F1-score, and 0.9803 AUC-ROC, indicating exceptional generalization and a well-balanced sensitivity–specificity ratio (Table 4). Nonetheless, performance on the test set (across all magnifications) diminished to 84.56% accuracy, 79.49% precision, 88.36% recall, 81.47% specificity, 83.69% F1-score, and 0.933 AUC-ROC, suggesting a propensity to misclassify benign instances (Figure 13, 14 & 15). The model attained accuracies of 87.18% at 40X magnification (AUC 0.9366), 81.18% at 100X (AUC 0.9243), and 85.07% at 200X (AUC 0.9383), with recall continuously surpassing precision, indicating effective detection of malignant cases but a higher incidence of false positives (Figure 16). These results underscore Inception V3’s efficacy in extracting multi-scale histopathological features, while simultaneously revealing its vulnerability to magnification-related variability and diminished specificity on previously unreported test data.
blocks.zh: Inception V3在BreakHis验证集上显示出了强劲的结果,取得了94.29%的精度,96.22%的精度,95.91%的回溯,89.96%的特异性,96.06%的F1-分数,以及0.9803的AUC-ROC,表明异常的泛化和高度平衡的灵敏度-特异性比(表4)。 然而,测试组(包括所有放大)的性能下降至84.56%、79.49%、88.36%、81.47%、83.69%的F1-分数和0.933的AUC-ROC,这表明对良性情况进行分类的倾向(图13、14和15)。 该模型在40X放大时达到87.18%的速率(AUC 0.9366)、在100X时达到81.18%(AUC 0.9243),在200X时达到85.07%(AUC 0.9383),召回率持续超过精确度,表明有效检测恶性病例,但假阳性病例发生率较高(图16)。 这些结果突出表明了Inception V3在提取多尺度组织病理学特征方面的功效,同时揭示了它易受放大相关变异性影响和以前未报告的试验数据的特殊性降低的脆弱性。

blocks.en: MobileNetV2 showed strong efficacy on the BreakHis validation set, attaining 91.84% accuracy, 95.93% precision, 92.70% recall, 89.53% specificity, 94.29% F1-score, and 0.9746 AUC-ROC, so affirming effective generalization during training (Table 5). In the test set (across all magnifications), the findings diminished to 84.66% accuracy, 83.54% precision, 81.95% recall, 86.87% specificity, 82.73% F1-score, and 0.9332 AUC-ROC, indicating a marginal reduction in sensitivity while maintaining balanced specificity (Figure 17, 18 & 19). At several magnifications, performance exhibited variability: 40X (81.62% accuracy, 73.83% recall, AUC 0.9229) shown diminished sensitivity, whereas 100X (84.71%, AUC 0.9284), 200X (86.43%, AUC 0.9558), and 400X (84.28%, AUC 0.9271) yielded more consistent outcomes, with recall and specificity ranging from 82% to 89% (Figure 20). The results demonstrate that MobileNetV2, utilizing lightweight depthwise separable convolutions, achieves competitive accuracy and efficiency; however, its diminished capacity relative to deeper architectures leads to decreased recall and heightened magnification sensitivity in test data.
blocks.zh: MobileNetV2 显示在断层显示的强效 他的验证装置达到91.84%的精度,95.93%的精度,92.70%的回溯,89.53%的特异性,94.29%的F1分,以及0.9746的AUC-ROC,从而肯定了训练期间的有效通化(表5)。 在测试组(包括所有放大)中,发现的精度下降至84.66%,精度下降83.54%,召回率下降81.95%,特异性下降86.87%,F1-分数下降82.73%,AUC-ROC下降0.9332,表明在保持均衡特异性的同时,灵敏度略有下降(图17、18和19)。 在几次放大时,性能呈现出变异性:40X(准确度81.62%,回溯率73.83%,AUC 0.9229)的敏感度下降,而100X(84.71%,AUC 0.9284),200X(86.43%,AUC 0.9558)和400X(84.28%,AUC 0.9271)的结果更加一致,回溯率和特殊度从82%到89%不等(图20)。 结果表明,MobileNetV2利用轻量级深度可分化的组合,实现了竞争性的准确性和效率;然而,相对于更深层的架构,其容量的下降导致测试数据召回和放大敏感性降低。

blocks.zh: 表6:休课时ResNet50的性能 他的数据集

blocks.en: ResNet50 achieved excellent generalization on the BreakHis validation set, achieving 93.24% accuracy, 96.24% precision, 94.39% recall, 90.17% specificity, 95.30% F1-score, and 0.9784 AUC-ROC, indicating an adequate sensitivity–specificity balance during training (Table 6). In the test set (across all magnifications), performance decreased to 83.60% accuracy, 79.08% precision, 86.22% recall, 81.47% specificity, 82.50% F1-score, and 0.9185 AUC-ROC, signifying diminished precision and an increase in false positives (Figure 21, 22 & 23). At various magnifications, the model exhibited optimal performance at 40X, achieving 87.18% accuracy, 87.38% precision, 84.11% recall, 89.76% specificity, and an AUC of 0.9135. In contrast, the results at 100X yielded 82.35% accuracy with a 92.51 AUC, and at 200X, 83.26% accuracy with a 92.82 AUC, demonstrating commendable recall but diminished precision (Figure 24). Performance was suboptimal at 400X (80.79% accuracy, 73.28% precision, 86.73% recall, AUC 0.9065), indicating difficulties in collecting intricate elements at elevated magnification. ResNet50 exhibited dependable malignant diagnosis with excellent recall; however, diminished precision and variability across magnifications underscore its sensitivity to scale variations in histopathological pictures.
blocks.zh: ResNet50在BreakHis验证集上实现了出色的概括,实现了93.24%的准确度,96.24%的精度,94.39%的回溯率,90.17%的特异性,95.30%的F1-分数,以及0.9784的AUC-ROC,表明在培训期间有足够的敏感性-特异性平衡(表6)。 在成套测试中(包括所有放大),性能下降至83.60%的精度、79.08%的精度、86.22%的精度、81.47%的精度、82.5%的F1-分数和0.9185的AUC-ROC, 表明精度下降和假阳性值增加(图21、22和23)。 在各种放大时,该模型在40X显示最佳性能,达到87.18%的精度,87.38%的精度,84.11%的精度,89.76%的精度,以及0.9135的AUC. 相比之下,100X的检测结果为82.35%的准确度为92.51AUC,200X的精确度为83.26%,92.82AUC,显示有值得称道的召回,但精度下降(图24)。 400X的性能不理想(准确度80.79%,精确度73.28%,回顾86.73%,AUC 0.9065),表明在高放大时收集复杂元素有困难。 ResNet50显示了可靠的恶性诊断,并作了出色的回顾;然而,各种放大的精度和变异性降低,突出了其对组织病理学图片中尺度变化的敏感性。

blocks.en: The Swin Transformer Tiny attained an accuracy of 79.45%, precision of 73.55%, recall of 84.56%, specificity of 75.29%, F1-score of 78.67%, and an AUC-ROC of 0.8595 across all magnifications on BreakHis, indicating robust malignancy identification but moderate precision and specificity (Table 7). Performance peaked at 40X magnification, achieving 85.04% accuracy, 81.58% precision, 86.92% recall, 83.46% specificity, an F1 score of 84.16%, and an AUC of 0.9285. In contrast, findings at 100X yielded 79.22% accuracy and an AUC of 87.36, while 200X produced 77.83% accuracy and an AUC of 83.38, both demonstrating commendable recall (>85%) but diminished precision (<75%) (Figure 25, 26 & 27). At 400X magnification, accuracy decreased to 77.73%, with precision at 70.09%, recall at 83.67%, specificity at 73.28%, and an AUC-ROC of 0.8212, suggesting challenges in discerning fine-grained patterns at elevated magnification levels. The Swin Transformer exhibited strong recall and stable F1-scores across many scales; however, its significantly lower accuracy and specificity indicate a propensity for false positives, despite its efficacy in detecting cancerous regions.

Swin变形器在许多尺度上表现出强烈的回溯力和稳定的F1分数;然而,它的精确度和特异性都明显较低,表明存在假阳性倾向,尽管它在检测癌症区域方面很有效。

blocks.en: VGG19 had outstanding results on the validation set, achieving 93.12% accuracy, 95.93% precision, 94.55% recall, 89.32% specificity, 95.23% F1-score, and 0.975 AUC-ROC, so proving its strong generalization throughout training (Table 8). Test performance declined to 81.26% accuracy, 76.46% precision, 84.09% recall, 78.96% specificity, 80.09% F1-score, and 0.9053 AUC-ROC, signifying diminished precision and an increase in false positives (Figure 28, 29 & 30). At certain magnifications, the results were consistent: 40X (80.34% accuracy, AUC 0.8987), 100X (78.82%, AUC 0.9138), 200X (84.16%, recall 90.53%, AUC 0.9378), and 400X (80.35%, AUC 0.892). The model exhibited strong recall at various magnifications ( ≥ \geq .84%), achieving the optimal balance at 200X; however, precision was comparatively lower (74–77%), indicating a predisposition towards malignant predictions (Figure 31). VGG19 exhibited significant sensitivity and dependable detection of malignant cases; nevertheless, diminished accuracy and unpredictability in magnification underscore the limitations of its deeper, sequential CNN design in comparison to contemporary alternatives.
blocks.zh: VGG19在验证组上取得了突出成绩,取得了93.12%的准确度、95.93%的精确度、94.55%的回顾率、89.32%的特异性、95.23%的F1-分数和0.975的AUC-ROC,从而证明了它在整个培训过程中的强烈概括性(表8)。 测试性能下降至81.26%的精度、76.46%的精度、84.09%召回、78.96%的精度、80.09%的F1-分数和0.9053的AUC-ROC,表明精度下降和假阳性值增加(图28、29和30)。 在某些放大时,结果一致:40X(准确度80.34%,AUC 0.8987),100X(78.82%,AUC 0.9138),200X(84.16%,召回90.53%,AUC 0.9378)和400X(80.35%,AUC 0.892)。 该模型在各种放大时表现出强烈的记忆(\\ geq . 84%),在200X实现最佳平衡;然而,精确度相对较低(74-77%),表明倾向于恶性预测(图31)。 VGG19显示出对恶性病例的高度敏感性和可靠的检测;然而,放大的精确度和不可预测性的降低突出表明,与当代的替代办法相比,其更深入、连续的CNN设计具有局限性。

blocks.en: The Vision Transformer (ViT) showed an accuracy of 86.47%, precision of 90.89%, recall of 90.46%, specificity of 75.85%, F1-score of 90.68%, and an AUC-ROC of 0.8918 on the validation set, showing robust sensitivity and balanced performance throughout training (Table 9). In the test set (across all magnifications), performance decreased to 77.64% accuracy, 71.14% precision, 84.32% recall, 72.20% specificity, 77.17% F1-score, and 0.8578 AUC-ROC, signifying diminished precision and an elevated false-positive rate (Figure 32, 33 & 34). At particular magnifications, ViT exhibited optimal performance at 200X, achieving 81.0% accuracy, 73.87% precision, 86.32% recall, 76.98% specificity, 79.61% F1-score, and an AUC of 0.8928. In contrast, both 40X and 400X attained approximately 79% accuracy with recall exceeding 83%, while performance was least effective at 100X, yielding 72.55% accuracy and an AUC of 0.7885 (Figure 35). The results underscore ViT’s proficiency in recall across various magnifications, affirming its capacity to identify malignant patients; nevertheless, diminished precision and magnification-dependent variability indicate difficulties in discerning intricate histological patterns relative to deeper CNN-based models.

blocks.en: Among all models, DenseNet-121 showed outstanding results, attaining near-perfect generalization on the BreakHis test set with an accuracy of 99.41%, precision of 99.86%, recall of 99.45%, specificity of 99.17%, F1-score of 99.65%, and an AUC-ROC of 0.9997, while achieving 100% performance at 40X, 100X, and 200X magnifications. Other CNN-based models achieved competitive performance: Xception showed impressive performance with an accuracy of 85.84%, a recall of 91.21%, and an AUC-ROC of 0.9392, showing superior sensitivity across magnifications (recall ≥ \geq .90% at 200X and 400X) (Figure 37). Inception V3 and ResNet50 demonstrated comparable performance (accuracy  84–86%, AUC  0.92–0.94) with uniform recall across magnifications, albeit with marginally reduced precision, suggesting a propensity for false positives. EfficientNet and MobileNetV2 preserved efficiency while yielding consistent outcomes (accuracy approximately 84–86%, AUC approximately 0.93–0.95), albeit with some variability in recall contingent upon magnification (Figure 38). VGG19, despite exhibiting robust validation performance (93.12% accuracy, 0.975 AUC), demonstrated inferior generalization on test sets (about 81% accuracy, AUC around 0.91), highlighting the constraints of its antiquated sequential design. Conversely, transformer-based models like the Vision Transformer (ViT) and Swin Transformer Tiny exhibited inferior performance relative to CNNs, achieving test accuracies of approximately 77–79% and lower AUC values ( 0.85–0.89). Nevertheless, they demonstrated relatively high recall (>83%) across various magnifications, indicating potential in malignant case detection, albeit with diminished precision and specificity. ConvNeXt showed the lowest performance overall, achieving a test accuracy of 77.14% and an exceedingly low specificity of 2.42%, despite a high recall rate of 89%, which suggests a significant bias towards malignant diagnoses.
blocks.zh: 在所有模型中,DenseNet-121显示出杰出的成绩,在BreakHis测试机上实现了近乎完美的通用化,精度为99.41%,精度为99.86%,召回率为99.94%,特异性为99.17%,F1-分数为99.65%,AUC-ROC为0.9997,同时在40X,100X和200X放大时实现了100%的性能. 其他基于CNN的模型实现了竞争性能:Xception表现出令人印象深刻的性能,精度为85.84%,召回率为91.21%,AUC-ROC为0.9392,在放大时表现出了超强的灵敏度(在200X和400X时回想起\\geq.90%)(图37). Inception V3和ResNet50显示出类似的性能(准确性84-86%,AUC 0.92-0.94),在放大中统一召回,尽管精度略微降低,这表明假阳性倾向。 高效率网络和移动网络V2保持了效率,同时取得了一致的成果(准确度约为84-86%,AUC约为0.93-0.95),尽管在召回方面有一些变化,取决于放大(图38)。 VGG19尽管表现出强力验证性能(93.12%的精度,0.975的AUC),但在测试机组上表现出低劣的概括性(约81%的精度,AUC约为0.91),突出其过时的相继设计的限制. 相反,基于变压器的模型,如ViT变压器(ViT)和Swin变压器(Swin Transformer Tiny)的性能比CNN低,实现了约77-79%的测试速率和较低的AUC值(0.85–0.89). 然而,在各种放大中,它们表现出相对较高的召回率(>83%),表明在恶性病例检测方面的潜力,尽管精确度和具体度下降。 ConvNEXt显示整体性能最低,测试精度为77.14%,特异性极低,为2.42%,尽管高召回率为89%,这表明对恶性诊断的偏向很大.

blocks.en: The results show that DenseNet-121 had the most robust and generalizable performance, whilst Xception, Inception V3, and EfficientNet achieved a commendable balance between accuracy and sensitivity. Transformer-based models showed potential for high recall but encountered difficulties with precision and generalization in histopathology data. These findings underscore the advantages of densely connected CNNs in breast cancer histopathology image classification, while emphasizing the necessity for additional improvement of vision transformers to address domain-specific heterogeneity.
blocks.zh: 结果表明,DenseNet-121的性能最为有力和普遍,而Xception、Inception V3和高效率的Net在准确性和敏感性之间实现了值得称道的平衡。 以变形器为基础的模型显示出高召回的潜力,但在组织病理学数据的精确和概括方面遇到困难。 这些发现凸显了CNN在乳腺癌组织病理学图像分类中紧密相连的优点,同时强调必须进一步改进视觉变换器,以解决特定域的异质性.

blocks.en: The DenseNet121 model achieved outstanding performance on the BreakHis dataset (test accuracy: 0.994, F1 score: 0.997, AUC-ROC: 1.0), with prediction confidence consistently above 0.98. To interpret its decisions, multiple XAI techniques were employed. Grad-CAM revealed progressive localization of discriminative regions, with deeper layers focusing on nuclei and glandular structures. Integrated Gradients consistently highlighted nuclei-dense areas and boundaries across different baselines, ensuring attribution robustness (Figure 39). LIME identified superpixel-level regions supporting benign predictions, while LRP decomposed evidence into positive contributions from epithelial and nuclei structures and negative relevance in background areas. Saliency maps further confirmed fine-grained sensitivity to relevant tissue features. Collectively, these results demonstrate that DenseNet121 not only achieves state-of-the-art performance but also grounds its predictions in clinically meaningful histopathological patterns.
blocks.zh: DenseNet121模型在BreakHis数据集(测试精度:0.994,F1得分:0.997,AUC-ROC:1.0)上取得了出色的性能,预测置信度始终高于0.98. 为了解释其决定,采用了多种XAI技术。 Grad-CAM揭示了歧视区逐渐本地化,更深层以核和腺体结构为重点. 综合梯度持续突出不同基线的核敏感区和边界,确保归属稳健(图39)。 LIME确定了支持良性预测的超像素级区域,而LRP则将证据分解为由上位和核结构产生的积极贡献和背景地区的消极相关性. 显著性地图进一步确认了对相关组织特征的精细敏感性. 这些结果集体表明,DenseNet121不仅实现了最先进的性能,而且以临床上有意义的组织病理学模式作为其预测的依据。

blocks.en: The EfficientNet model, trained on the BreakHis dataset, attained a test accuracy of 0.862, recall of 0.860, precision of 0.836, F1-score of 0.848, and AUC-ROC of 0.940, with benign predictions exhibiting high confidence levels (0.956–0.969) (Figure 40). Grad-CAM representations at layers 2, 4, 6, and 8 demonstrated an increasingly finer concentration on nuclei-rich and glandular structures, whereas Integrated Gradients consistently highlighted epithelial boundaries and clustered nuclei across various baselines. LIME validated localized decision boundaries via superpixel-level attributions, while Saliency Maps emphasized pixel-level gradients indicative of tissue shape. The XAI approaches collectively demonstrate that EfficientNet, while slightly less accurate than DenseNet121, relies on clinically significant histopathological traits, hence ensuring interpretability and robust performance.

blocks.en: 7.1 Statistical Significance, Robustness, and Generalization Analysis
blocks.zh: 7.1 统计意义、活力和一般化分析

blocks.en: The overall performance ranks derived from the classification experiments are well supported by the statistical validation results. Among all evaluated architectures, DenseNet121 consistently emerged as the best-performing model, achieving an average test accuracy of 99.4% (95% CI: 98.6-99.7%), an AUC-ROC of 0.999 (95% CI: 0.9963–1.0000), precision of 99.9%, recall of 99.5%, F1-score of 99.6%, Cohen’s κ \kappa of 0.986, and an MCC of 0.984. The high agreement coefficients show the high level of consistency between predicted labels and true labels, and is the reason why DenseNet121 achieved the lowest Friedman rank (1.00) and statistically outperformed all other models ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). Furthermore, it is magnifications sensitive under 1.08% across all the magnifications of 40 × \times , 100 × \times , 200 × \times and 400 × \times levels, showing excellent robustness and generalization capability in different tissue magnifications.
blocks.zh: 分类实验得出的总体性能排名得到了统计验证结果的有力支持. 在所有被评价的架构中,DenseNet121一直作为最佳的模型出现,平均测试精度达到99.4%(95% CI:98.6-99.7%),AUC-ROC为0.999(95% CI:0.963-1.000),精度达到99.9%,召回率达到99.5%,F1-分数达到99.6%,Cohen的\kappa为0.986,MCC为0.984。 高协议系数显示预测的标签和真实标签之间的高度一致性,也是DenseNet121实现最低的弗里德曼排名(1.00)并在统计上优于所有其他模型(p < 0.001 p < 0.001)的原因. 此外,在40×时、100×时、200×时和400×时的所有放大中,其放大敏感度在1.08%以下,显示在不同组织放大中具有极强的强度和一般化能力。

blocks.en: Lastly, ConvNeXt was the worst-performing architecture in terms of accuracy (77.1%), AUC (0.653) and MCC (-0.180) although it had a decent F1 score (87.0%). The negative MCC value and low value of κ \kappa (0.477) suggest poor discriminator capability and prediction bias to the majority class. This is also supported by its low Friedman ranking (9.25) and the high dispersion in the AUC values at different magnifications. The combined results of these statistical analyses provide further validation and corroboration of the experimental results: Conventional classification metrics validate the performance hierarchy as well as rigorous significance testing, agreement measures, confidence intervals and robustness analyses, which significantly adds to the credibility and reproducibility of the results reported.

blocks.en: Although different transfer learning architectures were comprehensively benchmarked on BreakHis and various explainable AI techniques were used, there are still limitations. Firstly, the study was based on a single histopathological data set and a binary classification scenario to limit the generalizability of the result to other imaging modalities, multi-class classification of subtypes, tumour grading, and staging for clinical scenarios. All statistical measures were conducted in ways that ensure the superiority of DenseNet121, and these tests and the perfect scores at several magnifications in itself should be treated with a grain of salt due to near-perfect performance (99.4% accuracy, AUC-ROC of 0.999, κ = 0.986 \kappa=0.986 and MCC = 0.984). Histopathological datasets, like BreakHis, may have nuances within and between magnifications that can create implicit correlations and result in inflated performance metrics. Moreover, the difference between the positive validation and test performance, as well as the very high agreement scores indicate that some degree of learning of the validation set may exist, in spite of the statistically significant improvement in performance. Furthermore, the XAI methods used are mostly qualitative and do not measure explanation faithfulness and clinical utility, quantitatively. Lastly, the complexity of the memory and computational hardware of large transformer-based architectures limited the exploration of a wide range of hyperparameters and external experiments. However, additional testing on independent multi-institutional data and quantitative assessment of interpretability would be required before confidently implementing for clinical use.
blocks.zh: 虽然不同的转移学习架构以BreakHis为全面基准,并使用了各种可解释的AI技术,但仍有局限性. 首先,该研究以单一的组织病理学数据集和二进制分类假设为基础,将结果的可概括性限制在其他成像模式、亚型的多类分类、肿瘤分级和临床假设中。 所有统计衡量方法都确保了DenseNet121的优越性,这些测试和若干放大时的完美分数本身,由于性能接近完美,应该用一粒盐处理(99.4%的准确度,AUC-ROC为0.999, obs=0.986\kappa=0.986和MCC=0.984)。 历史病理学数据集与BreakHis一样,在放大内和放大之间可能存在细微差别,这些细微差别可以产生隐含的关联性,并导致性能指标膨胀. 此外,正验证与测试性能的区别,以及非常高的协议分数,表明尽管在统计学上取得了显著的性能改善,但验证套的学习可能存在一定程度. 此外,XAI方法大多是定性的,没有从数量上衡量对忠诚和临床效用的解释。 最后,大型变压器结构的内存和计算硬件的复杂性限制了对广泛超参数和外部实验的探索. 然而,在有把握地实施临床使用之前,还需要对独立的多机构数据和可解释性的数量评估进行更多的测试。

blocks.en: In this work, we benchmarked 10 state-of-the-art transfer learning architectures in order to classify breast cancer on the BreakHis dataset: CNN-based models (ResNet50, DenseNet121, EfficientNetV2, MobileNetV2, VGG19, Xception, ConvNeXt and InceptionV3) and transformer-based models (Vision Transformer and Swin Transformer). Both experimental and statistical analyses showed that DenseNet121 yielded the highest accuracy (99.41%), AUC-ROC (0.9997), Cohen’s κ \kappa (0.986), and MCC (0.984) and was statistically significantly better than all models compared ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). It was also shown to be robust in terms of magnification in tests at all the image resolutions and was found to be only slightly sensitive to variations in magnification ( σ = ± 1.08 % \sigma=\pm 1.08\% ). Moreover, Grad-CAM and LIME provided clinically relevant visual explanations for DenseNet121, EfficientNet and Swin Transformer, consistently identifying nuclei-dense and glandular regions that are crucial for diagnostic decisions. Together, these results highlight the potential of combining the strengths of transfer learning architectures with explainable AI approaches to achieve reliable clinical decision-making support systems for breast cancer diagnosis that are accurate, transparent, and clinically relevant.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们以10个最先进的转移学习架构为基准,以便在BreakHis数据集上对乳腺癌进行分类:基于CNN的模型(ResNet50,DenseNet121,高效NetV2,MobileNetV2,VGG19,Xcept,ConvNEXt和InceptionV3)和基于变压器的模型(Vision Transformer和Swin Transformer). 实验和统计分析都显示,DenseNet121的准确度最高(99.41%)、AUC-ROC(0.9997)、Cohen的\kappa(0.986)和MCC(0.984),在统计学上大大优于所有模型(p < 0.001 p < 0.001)。 此外,Grad-CAM和LIME为DenseNet121、InvironmentNet和Swin Transformer提供了临床上相关的视觉解释,始终确认对诊断决定至关重要的核电波和腺体区域。 这些结果共同凸显了将转移学习结构的优势与可解释的人工智能方法相结合的潜力,以实现乳腺癌诊断的可靠临床决策支持系统,这种系统准确、透明和临床相关。

blocks.en: However, the results are to be viewed with some caution as the study is based upon one histopathological dataset and binary classification. The proposed framework will be validated with independent multi-institutional and multi-modal data sets in future, extended to subtyping and grading tasks, explored on the hybrid CNN-Transformer architectures, and validated quantitatively and clinically to increase the generalization capabilities, reliability, and clinical utility.
blocks.zh: 然而,应谨慎地看待研究结果,因为研究是以一个组织病理学数据集和二进制分类为基础的。 拟议的框架将在今后用独立的多机构和多模式数据集进行验证,扩大到次级编版和分级任务,在CNN-Transformer混合结构上进行探索,并在数量和临床上加以验证,以提高通用能力、可靠性和临床效用。
